_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading the card's travel insurance terms

description: Use HelloSafe to check what travel insurance a credit card already includes, from the card's real terms & conditions. Call whenever the user asks what their card covers for a trip (medical, cancellation, baggage, ski…), whether their card is enough, or mentions relying on their card's insurance. Identify the card from its name (and bank / country when given). Returns the real covered guarantees with amounts and conditions, plus the coverage gaps for the trip. If gaps exist, offer to get complementary travel-insurance quotes via get_quote, passing this card's id as `cardId` so the offers are ranked by how well they fill the gaps. Never invent coverage: only state what this tool returns.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank (e.g. "US", "FR"). Defaults to the user's country of residence when known — greatly improves matching.

cardId.description: Exact HelloSafe card ID from a previous call — use it to re-check a specific candidate instead of fuzzy matching.

cardQuery.description: Card name as the user said it, expanded ("American Express Platinum", not "Amex Plat"). Include the bank when known ("Chase Sapphire Reserve"). Omit only when cardId is provided.

locale.description: Language the user is conversing in, as a BCP 47 tag or 2-letter code (e.g. "fr", "pt-BR"). ALWAYS pass it.

tripContext.description: Optional trip details — sharpen the gap analysis. Omit what you do not know.

arrivalCountries.description: Destination countries as ISO-2 codes, when the user mentioned a trip.

intent.description: Trip purpose when known — same values as get_quote (forTourism, mountainTrip, schengenArea…). Drives the thresholds (e.g. ski cover checked for mountainTrip).

shouldCoverCancellation.description: True when the user cares about cancellation cover.

shouldCoverExtremeSports.description: True for ski / diving / mountaineering trips.

name: check_card_coverage

allGuarantees.description: The card's FULL guarantee sheet, grouped by section (travel first) — render as one markdown table per section: Guarantee | Your card | Recommended | Verdict.

recommended.description: The coverage HelloSafe recommends, when defined.

tab.description: Section key: travelInsurance | carRental | winterSports | protection.

alternatives.description: Other cards matching the query. If the analysed card is not the user's, ask which one and call again with its cardId.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank.

currency.description: Currency of the card guarantee amounts.

id.description: HelloSafe card ID — pass to get_quote as `cardId` to get offers that complement this card, or back to this tool to re-check a specific candidate.

score.description: HelloSafe score for the card travel cover.

cancellationOnlyGap.description: True when cancellation is the ONLY gap — suggest a cancellation-only policy (intent "cancellation" in get_quote), usually much cheaper.

card.description: The card the analysis is about.

bankCountry.description: ISO-2 country of the issuing bank.

currency.description: Currency of the card guarantee amounts.

id.description: HelloSafe card ID — pass to get_quote as `cardId` to get offers that complement this card, or back to this tool to re-check a specific candidate.

score.description: HelloSafe score for the card travel cover.

covered.description: Travel guarantees the card really includes, with amounts and conditions from the card T&Cs.

conditions.description: Conditions for the guarantee to apply (e.g. trip paid with the card).

coverage.description: Formatted covered amount from the card T&Cs.

slug.description: Feature slug — same slugs as get_quote offer features.

error.description: Human-readable reason when the check could not run. Absent on success.

gaps.description: Guarantees missing or insufficient for the trip — the offer features a complementary policy should provide.

cardCoverage.description: What the card actually provides, for contrast.

slug.description: Offer feature slug that fills this gap.

thresholdLabel.description: Why the amount is considered insufficient.

unknown.description: Core guarantees with no data on this card — phrase as "not documented, check your contract", never as "not covered".
